hero.title: A role, a project, a rematch?
hero.lede: A question, a project, some player feedback? Write to the studio: every message is read by a real person. No bots, apart from the ones coded here.

recruiting.name: Recruiting
recruiting.hint: A role, a team to join
recruiting.tip: The role, the team, the stack: anything that seems useful.
recruiting.messagePlaceholder: Hello, we are looking for a Senior Fullstack engineer to…
recruiting.delay: Recruiting? The reply offers a time slot to talk it through.
recruiting.ok: The message is on its way. The reply will offer a time slot to talk it through.

freelance.name: Freelance
freelance.tip: The need, the context, the budget if known.
freelance.messagePlaceholder: Hello, we have a project to…
freelance.delay: A project? The reply comes with precise questions, or a time slot.
freelance.ok: The message is on its way. The reply will come with precise questions, or a time slot to discuss it.

press.name: Press
press.tip: The angle, the visuals needed, the deadline.
press.messagePlaceholder: Hello, we are preparing a piece on…
press.delay: Press? Visuals and information come attached to the reply.
press.ok: The message is on its way. Visuals and information will follow in the reply.

player.name: Player
player.hint: A bug, an idea, a GG
player.tip: For a bug: what you were doing, the device, the browser.
player.messagePlaceholder: Hello, during a ranked match this happened…
player.delay: A bug? All player feedback is read, and bugs come first.
player.ok: Thanks for the feedback. All of it is read, and bugs come first.

form.privacy: The message goes to the studio's inbox. Your details are only used to reply: no mailing list, no resale.

errors.nameMissing: Name missing: it is used to address the reply.
errors.handleMissing: In-game name missing: it is used to address the reply.
errors.emailMissing: Email missing: that is where the reply will arrive.
errors.emailNoTld: The end of the address is missing, for example “.com”.
errors.emailInvalid: This does not look like an email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.messageShort: Message too short: {min} characters minimum, {missing} more to go.
errors.summary: {count, plural, one {# field to fix before sending} other {# fields to fix before sending}}

failure.title: The message was not sent
failure.send_failed: Sending failed on our side. Nothing was erased: try again in a moment, or use one of the studio's networks.
failure.not_configured: Sending through the form is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was erased: meanwhile, the studio also replies on its networks.
failure.rate_limited: Too many messages in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.invalid: The message could not be validated. Check the fields, then try again.

ok.title: Message sent. The crow is on its way.
ok.crowAlt: The crow lands on its branch

availability.title: Availability
availability.text: Full-stack SaaS products, games and web experiences, real time, AI implementation and services (MCP, Skills, AI generation).

notFound.caption: ERROR 404 · empty branch
notFound.title: The crow has flown away. So has the page.
notFound.text: This address does not exist, or no longer does. Nothing is broken on the browser side: head back home, or over to the games.
